documents.name: press.md
documents.content:
# Widget Press

## Safety

Vent the chamber before maintenance.

## Temperature

Seal widgets at 412 kelvin.

documents.name: pump.md
documents.content:
# Coolant Pump

## Safety

Disconnect electrical power before maintenance.

## Pressure

Keep coolant pressure below 18 bar.

documents.name: tolerances.md
documents.content:
# Machining Tolerances

## Radial

Radial tolerance is 0.04 millimetres.

## Axial

Axial tolerance is 0.11 millimetres.

documents.name: storage.md
documents.content:
# Storage

Archive completed reports for seven years. Encrypt archived reports at rest.

documents.name: release.md
documents.content:
# Release Procedure

Run typechecking and integration tests before publishing a release. Tag the exact tested commit.

documents.name: travel.md
documents.content:
# Travel Expenses

Submit travel receipts within thirty days. Managers approve reimbursement requests.

documents.name: inventory.md
documents.content:
# Inventory

Count spare bearings every Friday. Reorder when fewer than twelve remain.

documents.name: batteries.md
documents.content:
# Battery Care

Store batteries at half charge. Avoid direct sunlight and temperatures above 40 Celsius.
